definitions.gloss: to worry, to be anxious, to be concerned
definitions.explanation: To feel uneasy or troubled about something that might happen or has happened.

examples.japanese: {心配|しんぱい}しないでください。
{子供|こども}の{将来|しょうらい}を{心配|しんぱい}している。
examples.english: I'm worried about my child's future.

examples.japanese: {心配|しんぱい}するほどのことではない。
{親|おや}に{心配|しんぱい}をかけたくない。
examples.english: I don't want to cause my parents worry.

examples.japanese: {地震|じしん}のあと、{家族|かぞく}のことが{心配|しんぱい}で{何|なに}も{手|て}につかなかった。
examples.english: After the earthquake, I was so worried about my family that I couldn't focus on anything.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY: {他動詞|たどうし} (transitive). Pattern: Xを{心配|しんぱい}する (worry about X) / Xのことを{心配|しんぱい}する (be worried about X).

ASPECT: ている indicates ongoing state. {心配|しんぱい}している = 'is worried' or 'is worrying.'

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{心配|しんぱい}をかける (cause worry to someone)
・{心配|しんぱい}が{募|つの}る (worry grows)
・{心配|しんぱい}ない (no worries)
・ご{心配|しんぱい}なく (don't worry - polite)

RELATED: The noun {心配|しんぱい} alone is very commonly used: {心配|しんぱい}だ (I'm worried).
